{{Quote|The Consortium is a real flooger-bed of intrigue.|[[Nek Bwua'tu]]|<ref name="Legacy of the Force: Tempest">''[[Legacy of the Force: Tempest]]''</ref>}}
The '''Hapes Consortium''', also known as just the '''Consortium''', was a matriarchal [[Monarchy/Legends|monarchy]] of the [[Near-Human|near-]][[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Hapan]]s in the [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster]], a closely packed [[Star cluster/Legends|star cluster]] located in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. [[Politics/Legends|Politically]] a [[consortium]], it was [[Capital/Legends|based]] on [[Hapes/Legends|Hapes]] and spanned 130 closely positioned star systems, each with at least one habited world and had existed since before [[3000 BBY]] after the [[Lorell Raiders]] were [[Battle of Lorell|wiped out]] by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].

The Hapes Consortium was one of the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy's]] few insular civilizations, and had undergone a long period of isolation, which caused several of its members to try to secede from the influence of Hapes, but they were quickly crushed. At one point, the Consortium encountered the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and was said to have fallen to them with some claiming that the actions of pacifists and diplomats had nearly ruined the Hapes Consortium, but it was believed that the Consortium were left to their own devices. Nevertheless, the Consortium was an independent affiliate of the Empire and there was a recorded [[Battle of Andalia|border skirmish]] between the two in [[Andalia system/Legends|Andalia system]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

Eventually they came into contact with both the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and the [[Singing Mountain Clan]] of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] and opened their borders to the rest of the galaxy.

==Overview==
{{Quote|No man can rule Hapes.|Prince [[Isolder]]|<ref name="DJ">''[[The New Jedi Order: Dark Journey]]''</ref>}}
The [[Hapan]]s were ruled by the [[Queen Mother]], who held court at either the [[Fountain Palace]] when on Hapes, or aboard the royal transport ship ''[[Star Home]]'' when traveling abroad. The title of Queen Mother was hereditary, passed down from mother to daughter. If the Queen Mother failed to have daughters, the wife of the firstborn son became Queen Mother. However, to be in the line of succession meant both the Queen Mother and her heir (the [[Chume'da]]) had to avoid constant attempts on their lives by jealous relatives who vied for the throne themselves. The great importance of the Queen Mother meant that any threats made against her was a ground for immediate execution.

In addition to the Queen Mother, there were also representatives from each Consortium member planet at the [[Hapan Royal Court|Royal Court]]. Their main purpose was to vote on matters of importance and to give updates on any political and social conditions of their home planets that may require the Queen Mother's attention. The Queen Mother had the final say on everything, and her word was considered law.

==History==
:''Main article: [[Hapan#History|Hapan history]]''
After the [[Battle of Lorell|defeat]] of the [[Lorell Raiders]] at the hands of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] circa [[4030 BBY]], the remaining population of Hapes, most of whom were female, decided to create a new government system which gave power to one woman. Given the title of Queen Mother, the chosen woman united the planets of the [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster]] and formed the basis of the Hapes Consortium. Later on, she would commission the building of ''Star Home'', a mobile replica of the [[Fountain Palace]] on Hapes that she would use when traveling abroad.

During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]], the Hapes Cluster was considered an [[Imperial client state]]. While the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] was easily absorbing, assimilating or destroying, bigger and stronger entities, the [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] curiously tolerated the independence of the Hapans. Palpatine's advisers considered that the Hapans served a political purpose: Palpatine wanted to use them as a negative example for his subjects, a showcase of how decadance and weakness can result from insulation and self-importance. Still, many wondered about this enigmatic tolerance, and supposed that the Emperor had some secret deal or admiration for the Hapans, or that he was courting the Queen Mother.<ref>''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

Around the same time ''Star Home'' was completed, the first Queen Mother sealed the borders of the Hapes Consortium from any outsiders and quickly captured more planets within the Cluster for the Hapans to colonize. After being isolated from the rest of the galaxy for almost 3000 years, the Hapes Consortium only opened its borders to the rest of the galaxy in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]] after an alliance was made between Queen Mother [[Ta'a Chume]] and representatives of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].

As of [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]], the Queen Mother was [[Tenel Ka Djo|Tenel Ka Chume Ta' Djo]]. In [[36 ABY]], her daughter and heir [[Allana Djo Solo|Allana]] was born. During the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], the [[Corellia/Legends|Corellian]] leadership planned on drawing the Consortium into the war on their side by assassinating Tenel Ka and Allana. The [[Battle of Hapes (Second Galactic Civil War)|result]] of their assassination attempt failed.

At some point, [[Roan Fel]] of the [[Fel Empire|New Empire]] married a woman named [[Elliah Fel|Elliah]]. She was later killed by the treacherous [[Imperial Knight]] [[Darth Havok|Eshkar Niin]], and the Hapan people blamed Fel for her death due to Niin being his knight. This apparently put major strains on relations between the Consortium and the Empire.

During the [[Sith–Imperial War]] and the [[Second Imperial Civil War]] that followed, Hapes remained neutral with their borders still open.<ref name="legacy9">[[Legacy (2006) 9|''Legacy'' (2006) 9]]</ref>

==Culture==
[[File:TenelKaDjo_Conviction.jpg|thumb|right|200px|[[Tenel Ka Djo|Tenel Ka Ta'a Chume Djo]], [[Queen Mother]] of the Consortium during the [[Second Galactic Civil War]]]]
:''Main article: [[Hapan#Culture|Hapan Culture]]''
Hapan culture, at least among the upper classes, was based on assassination attempts and struggles for power. Most upper class Hapans would think nothing of arranging the death of one of their own if it would advance their own cause.

The Queen Mother was treated like a goddess by the Hapans, and her selection of a consort was important to all her people. Candidates for the role of consort often came from the nobility, mainly to keep the gene pool vibrant. There were fierce rivalries between many noble houses over which house would get their sons to father the next Queen Mother, and nobles often plotted against both the consort and the heir of the Queen Mother who was not fathered by one of their own. It was because of this that Allana's paternity was kept secret, so all the noble houses would believe that one of their own possibly fathered her and would not harm her.

Due to the matriarchal society of the Hapes Consortium, men were often treated as second class citizens. Although most Hapan males were used mainly for breeding, some held positions of power, although their ability to use it was often limited. Some Hapan men who felt trapped by their position in society often ran away and became pirates. These men hid out in the Transitory Mists and preyed on unsuspecting vessels, at least until caught by passing Hapan [[Nova-class battle cruiser|''Nova''-class battle cruisers]]. When captured, they would be put on trial and possibly executed depending on how severe the charge was.

[[Anti-Jedi sentiment/Legends|Anti-Jediism]] was rife among the Hapans, mainly due to the fact that the Lorell Raiders had fallen to the Jedi. This sentiment came to head during the reign of [[Ni'Korish]]. Ni'Korish had an immense hatred of Jedi and had done her best to wipe out any that had made their way into the Consortium. Because of this, an [[Ni'Korish (faction)|anti-Jedi faction]] that had formed among the Hapans during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] was named after her.

==Military==
{{Quote|True to our pirate roots, the Hapans prefer swift, ruthless strikes. Hurt an enemy at the start of an engagement and he is yours, for as the fight progresses, his fear of you will intensify and will become your ally.|Prince [[Isolder]] discussing Hapan battle tactics with [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]]|<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Agents of Chaos II: Jedi Eclipse">''[[The New Jedi Order: Agents of Chaos II: Jedi Eclipse]]''</ref>}}
Among the founding principles of the Consortium and the Hapes Cluster was the construction as well as maintenance of a strong military.<ref name="CTD">''[[Cracken's Threat Dossier]]''</ref>

One of the higher authorities amongst the Hapes Consortium was held by the [[Hapan Royal Guard]]. These individuals wore crimson clothing which identified their status. Prince Isolder had a private Hapan Guard led by Captain Astarta. The uniforms were one piece, and were similar to a flight suit. They were quite fitted, in addition to being deep red in color.<ref name="DJ" /> In addition to them, an elite commando force was present in the form of of [[Her Majesty's Select Commandos]] that were tasked with important missions.

The [[Hapan Security]] acted as the primary [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|Law enforcement agency]] for the Consortium.

In space, Hapes was defended by the skilled [[Hapan Royal Navy]].

==Commerce==
The Hapes Consortium possessed a vast amount of wealth which meant that only strong trading groups had a hope of dealing with their traders on an equal basis. After their re-emergence following their isolation, trade was done mostly in the form of goods and the Hapans continued to circulate their own currency which at that time was of a higher value than the New Republic credit, Republic Credit, and even Imperial Credit when it existed. This meant that the Hapan credit conversion was greatly in their own favor.<ref name="CTD" /> The fantastic amount of wealth available to them also included unique treasures such as [[rainbow gem]]s and [[Gun of Command|guns of command]] fetching high prices on both legal and illegal markets.

Even though businesses could operate on any of the 130 planets, Hapan law dictated that all major financial and business transactions must be conducted on Hapes.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
According to the ''Essential Atlas'', the Hapes Consortium was a "independent affiliate" of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], during the Empire's rule over the galaxy. According to other sources, the Consortium was isolated from the rest of the galaxy during the reign of the Empire and of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].
